{{Quote|We have been dug in here on Eliad for many months, and though the battle has been hard-fought, we have held our ground. We are receiving similar reports from Jedi forces on other planets in the Minos Cluster. I hope these developments have been relayed back to Coruscant so that spirits may be lifted during these dark times.|Jedi Knight Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
The '''Battle of Eliad''' was a significant engagement of the [[Minos Cluster Campaign]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Beginning in [[3680 BBY]], the battle was waged between the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and those of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in alliance with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The conflict began when the Empire launched its invasion of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] in the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, a move that shocked the Republic and sent the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] into panic. In response to the offensive, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] dispatched a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] to ferry [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to the frontlines in the Minos Cluster, including the embattled planet of [[Eliad]], where the Empire had commenced a massive invasion. For [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders and Imperial conquerors engaged one another in a sustained stalemate, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. Although the battle for Eliad later turned in favor of the Jedi and Republic, the larger campaign continued throughout the twenty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war. The Sith were eventually recalled from the Minos Cluster in preparation for the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], effectively forfeiting any persisting contest on Eliad and in the greater Minos Cluster.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Council has decided that we must take action. Even now, myself and hundreds of other Jedi are en route to help defend the Minos Cluster. Let us hope that the Senate will soon follow suit and deploy more military resources to assist us.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
The Battle of [[Eliad]] was a conflict spurred on by the overtures of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of its invasion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="JoMGD" /> In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] led their refurbished Empire into the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], making many drastic and successful advances into enemy territory. The early focus of the war was in the Outer Rim, where [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic security forces]] struggled to mount a concentrated defense. As a result, the Empire swept across the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], [[Tingel Arm campaign|scattering]] their opponent's [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] and sending shockwaves throughout the Republic's populace. Deliberation and cooperation turned to gridlock on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;a situation made even more dire with the Empire's invasion and seizure of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], a resource-rich region in the Outer Rim.<ref name="JoMGD" />

While the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] [[Senate emergency defense session|debated fruitlessly]] on appropriate courses of action, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] authorized a fleet of [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] to ferry [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to the front for the defense of the Minos worlds. In [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] departed Coruscant, leaving behind the rapidly deteriorating [[Politics/Legends|political]] arena for a rapidly deteriorating tactical theater.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I have battled many Imperial soldiers in the weeks since we first arrived, but I only recently came face-to-face with a young Sith. From the accounts of their ferocity, I had feared such a confrontation, but fortunately, he was overconfident. The duel was short and his defeat came quickly.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
[[File:Prisonersofwar.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Republic prisoners of war, captured along the Rimma Trade Route]]
Upon reaching the Minos Cluster, a number of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] vessels deployed to Eliad, where the Empire had launched a massive invasion led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and enforced by numerous [[Imperial soldier]]s. The Jedi made landfall and engaged the enemy, but their arrival did not reflect a quick success. Instead, the belligerent forces dug into the world, fighting one another for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] on end and suffering heavy losses as a result. The challenges faced by the Jedi were only amplified by events along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], which had been [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockaded]] by Imperial ships to prevent the free flow of goods and war materiel to the frontlines of the Minos Cluster.<ref name="JoMGD" />

Several months into the engagement, the Jedi began to see increased success in their defensive actions, slowly turning the tide of the battle in their favor. Prior to this point, the Sith had managed to confound their efforts through overwhelming force and control of the Rimma Trade Route, having managed to fend off Republic [[First battle of the Seswenna sector|efforts]] to free the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and deliver much-needed supplies to the Jedi combatants. However, around this time the Republic managed to regroup and [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector|break]] the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]&mdash;a development which occurred in conjunction with a significant Jedi victory on Eliad's surface.<ref name="JoMGD" />

[[Gnost-Dural]], a young [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] Jedi Knight, contributed to that victory on Eliad by [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueling]] with a Sith Lord of the ancient [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]]. Although Gnost-Dural had feared direct confrontation with a [[Unidentified Sith (Eliad)|member]] of the notoriously fierce race, he was able to quickly defeat his opponent. After the fight, the Kel Dor Jedi took the Sith's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for examination and recorded his experiences in a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|personal war journal]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|In the days that followed, reports began filtering back of the brutal battle in the Minos Cluster and the heroism and sacrifice of the Jedi as they fought the Sith. As tragic as the news often was, I felt incredibly proud, and other Republic citizens must have felt the same.|Grand Master Satele Shan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
During the early days of the battle, [[Coruscant riots (3680 BBY)|riots and violent political demonstrations]] gripped Coruscant as the planet descended into panic. However, as reports of the Jedi's heroism and sacrifices began to filter back to the Republic's capital, morale was lifted and the demonstrations ended. While senators and Jedi resumed defense negotiations, Republic citizens flocked to military recruitment offices, creating a boom in enlistment numbers. Soon, [[Republic soldier]]s began to occupy the front lines, giving the Jedi a much needed reprieve and allowing them to be assigned to other theaters. Gnost-Dural was ultimately reassigned to serve with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and other commanders were brought into the theater.<ref name="JoMGD" /> By the third [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] of the war, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and [[Havoc Squad]]'s [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] had been given command of the Republic forces in the Minos Cluster, including any remaining defenders on Eliad.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The contest for the Minos Cluster continued throughout the twenty-eight years of the Great Galactic War and only came to an end when the Sith forfeited the region in preparation for their [[Sacking of Coruscant]]<ref name="TOR ToP 1">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Eliad was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] by [[Robert Chestney]] in his [[List of books|book]], [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]. The book is written as a series of first-person entries into a journal kept by the Jedi Master Gnost-Dural during the Great Galactic War and littered with notations by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], allegedly added during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. ''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'' was released [[December 16]], [[2011]] as part of the collector's edition bundle of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', to which Chestney also contributed.<ref name="JoMGD" />
